### Important Deadlines in NSW

- **Police Report** : Report the crash to the police as soon as possible, with a strict maximum of **28 days**.
- **CTP Claims** : Lodge your motor accident claim within **3 months** of the accident (note that lost earnings claims should ideally be lodged within 28 days).[[1]](https://baleboshevlawyers.com.au/motor-accidents/)[[2]](https://www.youi.com.au/car-insurance/articles/how-long-after-an-accident-can-you-claim-car-insurance)

If you can share the **date of the accident** and **type of injuries sustained** , I can help provide more tailored guidance on what you need for your specific CTP claim.
